symptoms: You will see many small grey spots on the leaves.
These spots are round and have a dark border.
The spots start on the lower leaves and move up the plant.
The spots can join together and cause the leaves to wither.
The plant may lose all its affected leaves.
The disease can sometimes attack stems and flowers.
favourable_conditions: High humidity or dew at 25 degrees Celsius and moist weather with rain showers favor this disease.
prevention: Ask your local agricultural office for resistant or tolerant plant varieties.
Use seeds that have been treated to prevent infection.
Keep your fields clean to stop the disease from spreading.
practices: Remove and destroy any plant parts that look sick.
Monitor your plants regularly for signs of the disease.
Follow good field hygiene practices to stop the spread.
